verdict.rationale: Zulip is an API-bearing chat platform, so a sandbox or test-environment axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented sandbox, test organization, or isolated developer environment. Self-hosting a separate server or using export/import to stand up a copy would be user-side workarounds, not a product sandbox, and they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
